bear_case: Two of five regime triggers are now actively breached — VIX at 18.44 (above 17 add-gate) and DXY at 100.23 (above 100 trigger) — while a third (SPX 7,463.8 vs 7,460 floor) is within a rounding error of the breach level. Warsh's explicit abandonment of forward guidance means the 80% CME-priced hike probability could be reaffirmed at any FOMC-related communication event; there is no 'clarity' pathway short of a dramatic soft CPI print (next CPI is July). The 30Y approaching 5.00% is the most dangerous near-term trigger: if breached on a sustained close, it simultaneously voids NVDA's conditional-add framework, forces institutional bond-to-equity allocation re-weighting, and elevates mortgage rates in a way that has historically preceded equity multiple compression by 1–3 months. Juneteenth creates a 4-day low-liquidity window in which any adverse headline (Warsh hawkish speech, geopolitical setback, Chinese tech export controls on HBM) prices into thin markets Monday June 22. If SPX opens below 7,460 on June 22, the BUY call formally reverts to STEP_ASIDE and position sizing must be reduced immediately.
